headline: TOR @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 4.08 at NYY 3.83, with a projected total of 7.92. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TOR: TOR moved +0.01 runs while NYY moved -0.51, changing the projected margin by +0.53 runs. The projected total fell -0.50, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Dylan Cease has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Daulton Varsho, Jazz Chisholm Jr., Aaron Judge, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ryan McMahon, Austin Wells because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
